_comment: CAST v9 A1 — Egress / Privacy Sentinel policy data (SCAFFOLD — Ed owns the final values).
_thesis: Make 'know what leaves the machine' enforceable. The sentinel RECORDS every off-machine-bound tool call locally (the record-deepening thesis) and can advise/ask/block on sensitive content. Native permissions.deny/ask handle coarse tool+domain access; this layer adds local audit + content-sensitivity + credential-read correlation.
_mode_note: Enforcement MODE lives in ~/.claude/config/cast-cli.json -> egress_enforcement (advisory|ask|strict) or env CAST_EGRESS_ENFORCEMENT (takes precedence). This file holds POLICY DATA only.

mcp_servers._doc: Per-server cloud-bound classification. Transport (stdio vs http) is NOT a reliable signal: github uses local stdio (npx) yet calls api.github.com. Key = the <server> segment of mcp__<server>__<tool>.

credential_path_globs._doc: File paths that, when Read (or cat'd in Bash), count as a credential read. Logged always; escalated only if correlated with an egress event in the same session (compound detection = Ed's build).

bash_network_commands._doc: Bash binaries that can move data off-machine. git push is intentionally OMITTED (already gated by pre-tool-guard.sh CAST_PUSH_OK). Detection heuristics + exfil-pipe parsing are Ed's build — see docs/v9-a1-egress-sentinel.md Surface 3.

safelist_hosts._doc: Hosts/domains that suppress ADVISORY noise (still recorded, never warned/blocked unless sensitive content is detected). Loopback is always safe.

telemetry._doc: OTEL/telemetry exporters pointing off-machine. localhost/127.0.0.1 endpoints are local feeds (allowed by the thesis: OTEL is only ever a LOCAL feed).
